title: Descriptor State-Space
text: Model linear implicit system, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Initial condition} sets Initial state values; {E}, {A}, {B}, {C}, {D}, {Direct feedthrough} sets the whether output signal value depends on input signal, {Linearize to sparse model} sets the linearize states to sparse matrices, {Absolute tolerance} and {State Name (e.g., ’position’)} sets the option to assign unique names to states. Values come from the instance.

params.name: E
params.values: Mass matrix E of implicit system 1 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: A
params.values: A matrix of implicit system 1 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: B
params.values: B matrix of implicit system 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: C
params.values: C matrix of implicit system 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: D
params.values: D matrix of implicit system 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial condition
params.values: Initial state values 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Direct feedthrough
params.values: Whether output signal value depends on input signal value True (default) | False | Auto

params.name: Linearize to sparse model
params.values: Linearize states to sparse matrices on (default) | off

params.name: Absolute tolerance
params.values: Absolute tolerance for computing block states auto (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: State Name (e.g., ’position’)
params.values: Option to assign unique names to states ’’ (default) | character vector | cell array of character vectors | MATLAB ® variable |...
